notes: Availability and median speeds are Starlink's own published figures, read 2026-11-12. Speeds are residential medians as Starlink reports them and are not independent measurements. For some large countries Starlink publishes speeds by state or province only, so those show availability without a speed figure. Satellite positions are computed in your browser from orbital elements CelesTrak published 2026-11-12. They are close to live when the map is fresh and drift as it ages, because satellites manoeuvre. Every tracked Starlink payload is drawn, including ones still raising their orbit or retiring. The growth chart counts payloads by launch and decay date in the CelesTrak catalog.
